security_audit.summary: The static analyzer flagged Markdown backticks in SKILL.md as Ruby shell execution. Manual review found only documentation, skill lists, and copy-paste prompt examples, with no executable scripts or shell commands. No prompt-injection, data-exfiltration, network access, or secret-handling intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Use scanner rules that distinguish Markdown formatting from executable Ruby shell syntax in SKILL.md files.

remediation.issue: The workflow references many external specialist skills.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to confirm referenced skills are installed and trusted before invoking them.

content.value_statement: Complex application work spans setup, frontend, backend, testing, and deployment. This skill organizes those phases and points users to focused development workflows.
actual_capabilities: Breaks application delivery into setup, frontend, backend, database, testing, review, and deployment phases.
Lists specialist skills for React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, Prisma, testing, Docker, Vercel, and CI/CD.
Provides reusable prompts for invoking focused skills during each development phase.
Maps technology-specific workflows for React, Python, Node.js, full-stack, and mobile projects.
Defines quality gates for tests, review, security scanning, linting, and documentation.
limitations: It does not implement code by itself; it routes users to other development skills.
It does not verify that referenced skills are installed or available in the current environment.
It does not replace project-specific architecture, security, or deployment review.
It does not include runnable scripts, package manifests, or tool configuration files.

use_cases.title: Scaffold a New Product
use_cases.description: A founder can plan a full-stack build from stack selection through deployment checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Feature Delivery
use_cases.description: An engineering lead can assign frontend, backend, database, and testing work across a release.

use_cases.title: Modernize an Existing App
use_cases.description: A developer can use the phases to refactor legacy code and add quality gates.

prompt_templates.title: Start a New Web App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this development workflow to plan a React and Node.js application. Include setup, frontend, backend, testing, and deployment steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Full-Stack Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to break down a feature that needs UI changes, API endpoints, database updates, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Modernize a Legacy Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to plan modernization. Include architecture review, refactoring phases, test coverage, and deployment risks.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Production Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to prepare a production release plan with quality gates, security review, CI/CD, and rollback checks.

output: Phase plan covering setup, frontend components, API design, database schema, tests, review, and deployment.
Suggested specialist skills for React, backend architecture, TypeScript, database design, testing, and CI/CD.
Checklist for tests, code review, security scanning, linting, formatting, and documentation updates.
Release guidance that separates build preparation, deployment setup, and production validation.

output_examples.input: Choose a workflow for a mobile app.
output: Mobile development path with platform architecture skills and cross-platform implementation options.
Follow-up checks for testing, deployment readiness, and environment-specific validation.

best_practices: Confirm project scope, stack, permissions, and success criteria before invoking specialist skills.
Use the phase sequence as a checklist, then adapt it to the repository and deployment target.
Run tests, security review, linting, and documentation checks before release.
anti_patterns: Do not invoke every listed skill when a task only needs one focused workflow.
Do not treat example prompts as commands that must run without user review.
Do not skip environment-specific validation after planning or scaffolding.

faq.question: Does this skill write application code?
faq.answer: No. It organizes development phases and directs users toward focused skills that can support implementation.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it limited to web apps?
faq.answer: No. It covers web, backend, full-stack, and mobile workflows, with technology-specific sections.

faq.question: Does it include deployment guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes build, container, Vercel, and CI/CD workflow prompts.

faq.question: Can it replace security review?
faq.answer: No. It reminds users to run security scans, but it is not a security assessment.

faq.question: Why are many security findings present?
faq.answer: The scanner flagged Markdown backticks used for skill names and prompt examples. They are documentation, not executable commands.
